technique_name: Compare and contrast two leaders in the tech industry.
description: Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos are two of the most influential leaders in the tech industry. They have both been instrumental in pushing the boundaries of innovation and technology, often taking risks that many others are unwilling to take. However, their methods and approaches to leadership are quite different.
